damage_notes: Returned with dried concrete in the drum. Charged two hours of cleaning.
Returned two days late. No damage.
Puddle of oil under the chassis at check-in. Pump fitting loose; tightened and topped off.
Left front tire cut. Replaced and billed.
Customer reported the boom drifting down under load. Found a leaking seal on the jib cylinder.
Platform gate latch bent. Straightened in the shop.
Lift cylinder weeping hydraulic fluid. Platform would not hold height.
Bucket curl slow and jerky. Hydraulic oil low; topped off. Watch for a leak.
Fuel tank returned empty. Refuel charge added.
Slow to raise, hydraulic fluid low again. Same unit as the May problem. Sent to the shop.
Boom creeping down overnight. Jib cylinder seal again; replaced.
One lamp head cracked. Billed replacement.
